title: Gattefossé's Protecticire MB, natural waxes for the protection of hair fibers
summary: With Protecticire MB, Gattefossé introduces a 100% naturally derived active texturizing ingredient designed to help maintain hair quality over time. According to Gattefossé, Protecticire MB helps reduce breakage and split ends, protect color, and enhance softness, shine and lightness across a wide range of haircare applications.
